statement_nl: For a sign sequence s=(s_1,...,s_{n-1}) with entries plus 1 or minus 1, define V(s) subseteq {1,...,n} by: 1 belongs to V(s) exactly when s_1 = plus 1; n belongs to V(s) exactly when s_{n-1} = minus 1; and for 2 <= j <= n-1, j belongs to V(s) exactly when s_{j-1} = minus 1 and s_j = plus 1.
